name: Drakensberg
blurb: The Drakensberg mountain range in South Africa features the country's highest peaks, demanding multi-day routes like the Grand Traverse alongside rich botanical and wildlife viewing. Online conversations highlight outdoor adventures, local birdwatching, and regional climate research.

positive: Memorable multi-day backpacking treks and challenging hiking routes
Rich sightings of endemic birds, orchids, and diverse wildflowers
Striking mountain landscapes, sunsets, and natural spring streams
negative: Grumpy winter tent camping experiences while trying to boil water at high altitude
Safety concerns regarding occasional smuggling incidents in certain border regions
Challenging physical conditions including very hard trails with no markers

quotes.text:
🥾 TRAIL OF THE WEEK
Drakensberg Grand Traverse — South Africa
220km | +10,000m | 10-14 days | Very Hard
No trail markers, no rescue on speed-dial — just you, the escarpment, and Africa's highest peaks daring you to quit.
#hiking #trailoftheweek #trailnotesdaily #mountains

More from my recent South Africa trip. Drakensberg mountains Sani Pass a Drakensberg speciality and endemic, Drakensberg rock jumper. We saw a family party close to Lesotho border plus Drakensberg siskin and prinia

Drakensberg takes the toughest hike spot. We did a four day hike in Mnweni coming down Fangs pass. Large-ish group - 8 people. Although there have been incidents in that region due to smugglers operating between Lesotho and South Africa is fairly safe?

If you're sticking to the big nature reserves:
I have camped in a tent on the rocks of the Drakensberg Mountains during winter trying to boil water at altitude and you're damned straight that I was very grumpy.
